# Root Ripper

Internal ID: CrossbowRipperNature | Type: Crossbow | Source: Black forge | Usage: Ranged weapon | Wielding: Two-handed | Crafting Materials: Flametal x24, Jade x3 | Movement speed: -5%

# Introduction

Root Ripper is the upgraded form of Ripper using the Jade. Like all upgraded-weapons that use Jade, they gain 10 poison damage and their hit effect has a 20% chance to Immobilize.
An upgraded Ripper will NOT keep its upgrade level when it is modified using gemstones.
